faqs.question: What is customer support software, and why do Philippine businesses need it?
faqs.answer:
• Customer support software helps businesses organize customer inquiries, assign support tickets, and respond through a shared workspace.
  • In the Philippines, customers regularly contact brands through Facebook Messenger, Instagram, email, website chat, and other messaging platforms. When agents handle every channel separately, customers may wait longer and conversations become difficult to track.
  • MSG91 Hello is customer support software for Philippine businesses that combines messaging, AI chatbots, ticket management, and reporting in one place.
  • Whether you operate an online shop, educational institution, travel agency, or customer service team, Hello helps you manage inquiries with unlimited agents and no individual agent-license fees.

faqs.question: What is MSG91 Hello, and how does it work for businesses in the Philippines?
faqs.answer:
• MSG91 Hello is an AI-powered customer service platform that brings customer conversations, chatbot automation, tickets, and agent collaboration into one workspace.
  • Businesses can connect Facebook Messenger, Instagram, WhatsApp, email, website live chat, and other channels, then assign incoming tickets to their support teams.
  • The platform also includes a no-code chatbot builder. Teams can create an initial agentic AI bot using a prompt and add rule-based steps or API connections for specific tasks.
  • For example, an online store in Metro Manila can use a chatbot to answer delivery questions, collect order numbers, and transfer unresolved refund inquiries to a human agent.

faqs.question: Which communication channels does MSG91 Hello support in the Philippines?
faqs.answer:
• MSG91 Hello brings together Facebook Messenger, Instagram, WhatsApp, email, website live chat, SMS, RCS, X (Twitter), and configured calling services. Apple Messages for Business can also be considered where enabled.
  • Support agents can manage tickets, review customer details, and follow previous conversations from one shared inbox.
  • For example, a Cebu-based travel agency can handle booking questions through Messenger, itinerary requests through email, and website chat inquiries without opening separate helpdesk applications.
  • MSG91 Hello also provides a mobile app, helping Philippine customer service teams manage connected conversations while away from their desks.

faqs.question: Can MSG91 Hello combine rule-based chatbots and agentic AI in one bot?
faqs.answer:
• Yes. MSG91 Hello allows businesses to combine rule-based steps with agentic AI within one chatbot.
  • Rule-based steps collect structured information, such as booking references, order numbers, or appointment dates. Agentic AI then answers more detailed questions and retrieves information through connected systems.
  • For example, a Philippine courier company can first collect a tracking number, fetch shipment details through an API, and use AI to explain delivery delays.
  • The no-code AI chatbot builder includes different AI model choices, API workflows, multilingual conversations, and transfer to a human agent.
  • Businesses can configure an initial agentic AI chatbot in minutes.

faqs.question: Can multiple support agents use one WhatsApp Business number?
faqs.answer:
• Yes. Multiple agents can handle customer conversations from one connected WhatsApp Business number through MSG91 Hello.
  • Agents use their own logins, while managers can assign tickets, create departments, add internal notes, and monitor customer history.
  • For example, a Philippine electronics retailer can distribute product inquiries to sales, delivery complaints to logistics, and warranty concerns to customer support.
  • Hello also includes unlimited agents across its plans. Businesses can add seasonal support staff or grow their customer service teams without paying separate license fees for every new agent.
  • Want to make it easier for customers to contact your business on WhatsApp? Use MSG91's Free WhatsApp Link Generator to create click-to-chat links, QR codes and website chat widgets with optional pre-filled messages. Once your WhatsApp Business channel is connected to MSG91 Hello, your support team can manage customer conversations from the shared inbox.

faqs.question: Can Philippine customer support agents manage calls through MSG91 Hello?
faqs.answer:
• MSG91 Hello includes cloud calling and IVR functionality for configured customer support workflows.
  • Teams can manage call routing, organize customer requests by department, and review relevant call information alongside messaging tickets.
  • For example, a Philippine healthcare clinic can direct appointment questions, laboratory-result inquiries, and billing concerns to the appropriate staff.
  • The Hello mobile app also enables outbound customer support calls in configured calling environments.
  • AI voice assistance can help with suitable customer interactions, while telephone calling and website voice-bot capabilities require their respective configurations.

faqs.question: What is MSG91 Chat Window, and how does it help reduce WhatsApp support costs?
faqs.answer:
• MSG91 Chat Window allows customers to start a conversation on WhatsApp and continue longer support interactions inside a separate chat window connected to Hello.
  • For example, a customer may contact a Philippine online store through WhatsApp about a damaged appliance. The business can move the detailed troubleshooting conversation to Chat Window while keeping the support ticket connected.
  • Messages exchanged inside Chat Window do not incur Meta's WhatsApp per-message charges.
  • Messages actually sent through WhatsApp remain subject to applicable WhatsApp messaging rates.
  • This makes Chat Window useful for lengthy customer support conversations involving returns, technical questions, or delivery complaints.
  • Learn More About Chat Window.

faqs.question: How is MSG91 Hello different from Freshdesk, Zendesk, Zoho Desk, and Intercom?
faqs.answer:
• MSG91 Hello combines messaging, AI chatbot automation, ticket management, and agent collaboration with unlimited agents and no separate per-agent license fees.
  • For Philippine businesses that depend on social messaging and mobile communication, Hello provides a shared workspace for handling inquiries across connected channels.
  • Its chatbot can combine rule-based workflows and agentic AI, while Chat Window helps businesses continue WhatsApp-originated support conversations outside WhatsApp.
  • Other helpdesk platforms also offer AI, ticketing, and integrations, but their feature access and pricing depend on the product and plan.

faqs.question: What is MSG91 Hello pricing in the Philippines? Is there a free plan?
faqs.answer:
• Yes. MSG91 Hello offers two free plans and two paid monthly plans for Philippine businesses. Every plan includes unlimited agents and teams, with no per-agent licence fees.
    • Live Chat – £0/month: 1 inbox and unlimited live-chat tickets. Ideal for businesses that need a free website chat widget.
    • Free – £0/month: 2 inboxes and 50 tickets monthly. Suitable for small businesses getting started with customer support software.
    • Basic – £35/month: 2 inboxes, 1,000 tickets monthly and a £35 bot wallet for AI chatbot usage.
    • Premium – £65/month: 3 inboxes, 2,000 tickets monthly and a £65 bot wallet for AI chatbot usage.
  • Annual plans are also available. With no per-agent licence fees, MSG91 Hello helps Philippine businesses expand their customer support teams without increasing costs for every new agent.
  • Note: Prices are listed in GBP on the Philippines pricing page. Confirm the billing currency and applicable taxes before subscribing.
  • Explore MSG91 Hello Philippines Pricing

faqs.question: Are there additional charges for agents, tickets, inboxes, or AI bots?
faqs.answer:
• MSG91 Hello includes unlimited agents and teams across all plans, so Philippine businesses do not need to pay extra for each new support agent.
  • On paid monthly plans, additional usage charges include:
    • Extra inbox: £9 per inbox on Basic and Premium plans.
    • Extra tickets: £0.012 per ticket on Basic and £0.025 per ticket on Premium after the monthly ticket allowance is exhausted.
    • AI bot usage: Deducted from the included bot wallet according to the rate card. Businesses can top up their wallet when the balance runs out.
  • The Free plan does not allow additional inbox or ticket purchases. Businesses must upgrade to a paid plan when they need higher limits.
  • Separate messaging and calling charges may apply depending on the connected communication services.
  • View Complete Pricing

faqs.question: Is MSG91 Hello secure for Philippine businesses, and where is customer data stored?
faqs.answer:
• Yes. MSG91 Hello helps Philippine businesses protect customer information through encryption, role-based access controls, and secure conversation management. MSG91 has undergone a SOC 2 Type II audit and holds ISO 27001 certification, supporting its commitment to data security.
  • MSG91 stores customer data for Philippine businesses in regional Asia-Pacific data centers.
  • View MSG91 Security Certificates

faqs.question: Does MSG91 Hello offer free customer support software for startups in the Philippines?
faqs.answer:
• Yes. MSG91 provides a Hello Free for Startups programme for eligible early-stage Philippine businesses that need customer support software without an initial software subscription fee.
  • Registered startups with annual revenue below US$50,000 or the applicable local equivalent can apply for complimentary access, subject to verification.
  • The programme offers up to 1,000 monthly tickets, 50 agents, 2 inboxes and AI chatbot usage under a fair-use policy.
  • For example, a growing online store in Metro Manila can manage Facebook Messenger and website chat inquiries, automate common delivery questions and assign unresolved issues to its support team.
  • Business documents and financial information are required for approval. Additional messaging and calling charges may apply.
  • Apply for Hello Free for Startups in the Philippines

faqs.question: Can Philippine businesses reduce customer support software costs by almost 95% with MSG91 Hello?
faqs.answer:
• Yes. MSG91 Hello can provide approximately 95% lower estimated costs in selected comparisons with other customer support software, while allowing businesses to add unlimited agents without per-agent licence fees.
  • For example, with 3,000 monthly tickets, 12 support agents and 50% AI resolution:
    • MSG91 Hello: £59/month
    • Freshdesk: £915/month
    • Estimated savings: £856/month — 94% lower costs
  • Philippine businesses can compare Zendesk, Freshdesk, Zoho Desk, Intercom and other platforms by entering their ticket volume, agent count and AI usage.
  • The calculator supports GBP, matching the currency listed on the Philippines Hello pricing page. Results are estimates and actual savings may differ.
